field_edits.updated_text: Mild marginal osteophyte formation involving the tibial plateau, femoral condyles and patella. Mild subchondral sclerosis. No acute fracture or focal destructive osseous lesion.
Mild narrowing of the medial tibiofemoral and patellofemoral joint spaces consistent with mild tricompartmental degenerative osteoarthritic changes. No dislocation.
No significant joint effusion. The soft tissues are unremarkable.

impression:
1. Mild tricompartmental degenerative osteoarthritic changes of the knee.
2. No acute osseous abnormality.
